name: list_trigger_resources
description: List selectable GitHub resources for event-trigger dimensions (repositories, branches, authors). Use this when authoring a GitHub automation and you need the numeric repository id for dimensions.repo — backend rejects owner/name. Flow: automation_list_trigger_catalog → automation_list_trigger_resources (provider=github, resource_type=repository, optional query) → automation_create with dimensions.repo set to each resource's id (stringified). For branch/author suggestions, pass repo_ids from a prior repository listing. Resources are install-scoped (repos under the user's GitHub App installations that can receive webhooks). Linear resource kinds are not yet served.

provider.description: Trigger provider wire tag (v1: github). Must appear in automation_list_trigger_catalog for this account.

resource_type.description: Resource kind to list: repository (GitHub repos — id is the value for dimensions.repo), branch, or author (branch/author require repo_ids). Linear kinds are not yet served.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on display_name (e.g. 'xai' matches xai-org/xai). Page tokens are only valid for the query that produced them.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_page_token. Omit for the first page.

force_refresh.description: When true, bypass server-side cache and re-list from the provider. Defaults to false.

repo_ids.description: Stringified GitHub repository ids from a prior repository listing. Required for resource_type branch/author (max 5); ignored for repository. Bare numbers are also accepted.
